title: What happens if AC is not serviced?
desc: If an AC is not serviced, it may become inefficient and consume more energy. Regular maintenance prevents breakdowns and ensures optimal performance.

title: How do I know if my AC needs to be serviced?
desc: If your AC is blowing warm air or not cooling properly, it's a clear sign it needs servicing. Other indicators include strange noises, poor airflow, or unpleasant odors.

title: Are AC service installation repairs available?
desc: Yes, AC installation, maintenance, and repair services are available. These services include installation, routine maintenance, and repairs to ensure optimal performance. – By Umair, Technician of FAJ

title: What are the benefits of choosing AC repair service?
desc: Choosing a professional AC repair service ensures accurate diagnosis, improved efficiency, and extended system lifespan. It also enhances safety, prevents further damage, and saves time over DIY fixes. Regular maintenance helps prevent future breakdowns. – By Umar, Technician of FAJ

title: What is the process involved in an AC repair service?
desc: AC repair service typically involves diagnosing and fixing issues like leaks, low refrigerant, or faulty parts. Technicians ensure all components are functioning properly for optimal performance. Regular servicing helps maintain efficiency and prevents future problems.
